description: User-approved whole-repository cleanup: remove legacy runtime behavior, migrate retired persisted formats on update, unify MCP/provider/skill/instruction generation and docs, remove proven ballast.

acceptance_criteria: Every runtime candidate is classified as migration-only, current product behavior, security boundary, historical oracle, obsolete, or unresolved with evidence.
Every provider/profile generation surface has a traced source and drift finding.
All dirty/untracked work and active-plan overlaps are preserved and classified before overlapping edits.
task_cleanup_inventory.description: Classify actual callers and stored formats; map duplicate outputs, stale docs, dirty work, and active-plan overlap. No keyword-only deletion. Initial partial findings are recorded in docs/audits/2026-11-24-local-ai-hub-canonical-cleanup.md; they do not authorize removals.
task_cleanup_inventory.next_action: Continue source-linked migration-chain and caller mapping; reconcile active plan owners and update the audit before overlapping edits.
task_cleanup_inventory.title: Inventory contracts, legacy paths, generators, and ballast

acceptance_criteria: Release checks and targeted migration, contract, generator, and provider verification pass on integrated revision.
Every design criterion has current evidence; static, runtime, and provider acceptance are reported separately.
No goal requirement remains unresolved or unverified.
task_integrated_acceptance.description: Audit final revision across migrations, runtime boundaries, generated provider/profile surfaces, docs, and removal evidence.
task_integrated_acceptance.title: Verify integrated cleanup against full goal

acceptance_criteria: Each supported old persisted format has an explicit ordered migration.
Migrations preserve authoritative records, provide recoverability, validate output, and stop safely on ambiguity.
Current runtime does not read old persisted formats after migration.
task_migration_boundary.description: Convert retired persisted/config formats before current runtime opens state; preserve data and fail closed on ambiguity.
task_migration_boundary.next_action: Implement after inventory identifies supported formats and stores.
task_migration_boundary.title: Make update migrations sole old-format reader

acceptance_criteria: Current docs match implementation and generated surfaces.
Update docs describe migrations without runtime compatibility.
Retained historical artifacts have a migration, test-oracle, or evidence purpose.
task_reconcile_docs.description: Document migration-only upgrades and current runtime rejection; label retained history.
task_reconcile_docs.next_action: Reconcile docs after runtime and generator contracts are fixed.
task_reconcile_docs.title: Reconcile operator documentation and historical evidence

acceptance_criteria: Every removal is proven unused across imports, entrypoints, migrations, tests, and packaging.
No user work or supported upgrade path is removed.
task_remove_proven_ballast.description: Remove only unreachable modules, unused dependencies, duplicate outputs, and stale artifacts backed by reference evidence.
task_remove_proven_ballast.next_action: Remove bounded groups after inventory and overlap review.
task_remove_proven_ballast.title: Remove proven dead code and repository ballast

acceptance_criteria: Current boundaries accept one canonical shape and reject retired aliases with actionable errors.
No runtime dual-read/write or compatibility adapter remains outside migration code.
Authorization, identity, privacy, path, quality, and receipt gates remain intact.
task_remove_runtime_compat.description: Reject old names/shapes at API, MCP, SDK, configuration, and store boundaries; preserve current product behavior and security gates.
task_remove_runtime_compat.next_action: Remove only evidence-classified paths after migration acceptance.
task_remove_runtime_compat.title: Remove retired runtime aliases and compatibility paths

acceptance_criteria: All supported provider/profile schemas, skills, and instructions match active contracts.
Disabled actions and retired aliases are absent from generated output.
Shared contract text has one source; remaining differences represent host packaging.
task_unify_generators.description: Derive shared action/capability contracts and outputs from one active source; retain host-layout adapters.
task_unify_generators.next_action: Consolidate after mapping generator sources and active overlaps.
task_unify_generators.title: Unify MCP, provider, skill, and instruction generation

title: Local AI Hub canonical cleanup
